title: ORTHO-32 Fabric Completion
description: Fabric completion returned from ORTHO-32. cycles is architectural integer cycles, NOT wall-clock milliseconds. Wall-clock timestamps are recorded separately on the host.

cycles.description: ORTHO-32 architectural cycles (integer count). Not wall-clock time, not milliseconds, not nanoseconds.

traceRoot.description: Merkle root of cycle trace for this command, 64-char hex
